# capability_manager Usage Guide

<!-- socrates:section id="purpose" kind="purpose" tags="tools" -->
## Purpose

- `capability_manager`: Manage installed skills and MCP servers only when the user asks to add, update, enable, disable, or remove one. Skill create/update delegates to the Skill Writer; skill imports use the secure preview then commit flow. MCP configure validates before enabling and collects declared secrets through private credential input. Discovery is handled by automatic capability retrieval and read/search under socrates://capabilities, not by this tool.
<!-- /socrates:section -->

<!-- socrates:section id="when_to_use" kind="routing" tags="tools" -->
## When To Use

- Use `capability_manager` when the active task requires its cataloged mutation/execution capability.
- Automatic retrieval and socrates://capabilities search handle discovery. Use this manager only to check or mutate skills and MCP configuration; mutations require approval.
<!-- /socrates:section -->
